body.statement: There is a constant \(K=K(B,M,p)\) such that, for all sufficiently large \(n\), \(\max_{1\le r\le N_n+G_n}|D_{n,r}|\le K/G_n\) almost surely. Hence \(\max_r|D_{n,r}|/\sigma_n\to0\), and for every \(\varepsilon>0\), \(\sigma_n^{-2}\sum_r\mathbb E[D_{n,r}^2\mathbf 1\{|D_{n,r}|>\varepsilon\sigma_n\}\mid\mathcal F_{n,r-1}]\to0\) in probability.
body.justification: A transposition affects at most two groups or two labels, so bounded potential outcomes deliver the martingale Lindeberg condition from primitives.
body.gap: Chao1997 uses sequential permutation martingales, but it does not treat completed \(M\)-blocks followed by a fixed-count label permutation.
body.consumer: This removes a separate maximal-increment assumption from the centered design-based CLT.
